driver_review: 公開の疎倍数ゼータを2入力へ適用、各点の積、疎倍数メビウス、出力のみ。
照会のバッチ化/並べ替え/入力分布切替なし。ライブラリ内部の密疎切替はAPI一般の処理。
共通FastIO、先頭SKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS、本体込み、独自Mint付きでACLインストールへ依存しない。
coverage: オンライン問題は法998244353、長さ最大100万、密なkey1..nのprefix経路。
一般疎キーは独立ローカル参照で確認。正で一意、約数閉包という前提を満たすfixtureを使用。
空、未整列、反転、int8/uint8/uint16/int32/int64/uint64キー、符号付き/符号なし/Mod値型。
MoveOnlyと既定構築不可、dense-prefixの非確保、ソート/演算/確保失敗と所有権、共有guard。
意図的に衝突する9素数と1で7/8probe成功と8回後の二分探索を確認。計測用copyはカウンタ以外の逆変換byte一致をassert。

existing_coverage: Independent pairwise divisibility sums and trial-division Mobius; empty/singleton/dense/shuffled/closed sparse keys
int16,uint16,int32,int64 keys and uint8,uint16,uint64,int64,Mod values; move-only in prefix/general-dense paths
Sparse divisors360360 exception ownership/arithmetic/allocator injection already present
gaps_addressed_by_supplement: A fixture deterministically forces lookup depths7 and8 and eight-probe binary-search fallback. Instrumented and untouched source both pass direct definitions.
True sparse divisor-closed keys with non-default-constructible, noncopyable unique_ptr-owned values, ascending/reversed/shuffled.
int8,uint8,uint64 keys; largest/size boundary just above/exactly/below4 (largest40,size9/10/11).
Default checked mode rejects uint64 keys400001,4294967297,UINT64_MAX with sieve400000, before narrowing/indexing. Invalid inputs excluded in skip builds.

steps: Read vectors into positive key/value pairs with keys1..n
main_review.limitation: Online GCD input supplies all keys1..n in order, so it exercises the dense-prefix optimization. True sparse hash/transfers and shuffled keys are locally verified; do not describe online acceptance as checking those paths.

collision_fixture.method: Nine primes >=64 in one bucket; key1 supplies divisor closure. First8 primes stored, ninth must fall back to binary search; lookups at depths7/8 also occur.

independent_reference.note: 既存の独立な約数和/メビウス参照を、Python任意精度のGCD直接二重和100例および公式解と照合したもの。入力/参照出力のhashを再確認して再利用。

core_reference_note: 小規模の倍数和とmuの直接定義、独立な約数全列挙を参照。公式の期待値は素数別伝播を使わないO(N log N)約数和・メビウス逆算で生成し、Python任意精度のGCD直接二重和100例と公式解との既存照合を入力/出力SHA付きで再利用。

from pathlib import Path

r=Path('/home/reinsirk/Atcoder_Env');p=Path(__file__).parent;fixtures=json.loads((r/'Audit/verify-zeta-gcd-ready-2026-10-24.json').read_text())['verification']['fixtures'];fixtures=[f for f in fixtures if f['name']in ['random_00.in','max_random_00.in','near_prime_00.in','near_prime_squared_00.in']];d={};sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
with open('/tmp/sirkit_performance_cpu14.lock','a')as a,open('/tmp/atcoder_full_performance_20261018/benchmark.lock','a')as b:
 fcntl.flock(a,fcntl.LOCK_EX);fcntl.flock(b,fcntl.LOCK_EX)
 for f in fixtures:
  raw={v:[]for v in ['full','split']}
  for rep in range(9):
   for v in (['full','split']if rep%2==0 else['split','full']):
    with open(f['input'],'rb')as inp:
     before=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN);start=time.perf_counter_ns();q=subprocess.run(['taskset','-c','14',str(p/('gcc_native_skip_'+v))],stdin=inp,capture_output=True);after=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN);wall=(time.perf_counter_ns()-start)/1e6
    assert q.returncode==0 and not q.stderr and sha(q.stdout)==f['output_sha256'];raw[v].append({'cpu_ms':1000*(after.ru_utime+after.ru_stime-before.ru_utime-before.ru_stime),'wall_ms':wall})
  med={v:statistics.median(e['cpu_ms']for e in xs)for v,xs in raw.items()};d[f['name']]={'raw':raw,'medians_cpu_ms':med};print('native baseline',f['name'],med,flush=True)
(p/'baseline_native.json').write_text(json.dumps({'status':'PASS','measurements':d,'compiler':'/usr/bin/g++15.2','flags':'-std=c++23 -O2 -march=native -DEVAL -DONLINE_JUDGE SKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS','cpu':14,'repetitions':9,'limitation':'Intel i9-14900K、Library CheckerのAMD実機の実行時間を予測するものではない。'},indent=2))

 for skip in [False,True]:
  for form,lib in [('full','Math/Zeta_Mebius.cpp'),('split','Math/Zeta/Sparse_Transform.cpp')]:
   exe=p/'probe_repo';cmd=['taskset','-c','10',*cmdcc,'-std=c++23','-O2','-Wall','-Wextra','-Werror','-pedantic-errors','-DSOURCE="'+str(r/lib)+'"',str(test),'-o',str(exe)]
   if skip:cmd+=['-DSKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS']
   q=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True);assert q.returncode==0 and not q.stderr,(cmd,q.stderr);q=subprocess.run(['taskset','-c','10',str(exe)],capture_output=True,text=True);assert q.returncode==0 and not q.stderr,(cmd,q.stdout,q.stderr);rows.append({'command':cmd,'stdout':q.stdout});print(cc,skip,form,q.stdout.strip(),flush=True)
for skip in [False,True]:
 exe=p/'probe_san';cmd=['taskset','-c','10','clang++','--gcc-install-dir=/usr/lib/gcc/x86_64-linux-gnu/15','-std=c++23','-O1','-Wall','-Wextra','-Werror','-pedantic-errors','-DSIRKIT_DISABLE_SIMD','-U__SIZEOF_INT128__','-fsanitize=address,undefined','-fno-sanitize-recover=all',str(test),'-o',str(exe)]
 if skip:cmd+=['-DSKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS']
 q=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True);assert q.returncode==0 and not q.stderr,(cmd,q.stderr);q=subprocess.run(['taskset','-c','10',str(exe)],capture_output=True,text=True,env={**os.environ,'ASAN_OPTIONS':'detect_leaks=0'});assert q.returncode==0 and not q.stderr,(cmd,q.stdout,q.stderr);rows.append({'command':cmd,'stdout':q.stdout});print('SAN',skip,q.stdout.strip(),flush=True)

a='if (static_cast<std::uintmax_t>(f[index].first) == key) return index;'

limitations: ローカルPASSとオンラインACを区別し、過去の提出記録を現行のACへ書き換えない。
GCD Convolutionのオンライン結果だけで非連続キーや疎hash経路の正しさ/速度を検証したとは説明しない。
SKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKSでも有効な入力の前提、内部の容量/添字保護は必要。未参照篩部分や全閉包を一括検査できるとは説明しない。
